# Gone Fission: Fish Bits

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jun 2, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_55eebb6abe1c42f59d80984f496c7421~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Fish Bits__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_36a936065ec74fde9e221fb248655673~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

- Used to craft: 
 - Grilled Fish,
 - Fish and Tatos,
 - and Fish Chowder
- Can be given to Linda-Le in exchange for Scrip
- Can be eaten, but provides little to no benefit

**Buff Duration:**

- N/A

**Radiation:**

- 2 Rads

**Ingredients**

Each fish yields a certain amount of Fish Bits, depending on its size and classification.

**Small Fish**

- Gives 1 Fish Bit

**Medium Fish**

- Gives 2 Fish Bits

**Large Fish**

- Gives 5 Fish Bits

**Glowing Small Fish**

- Gives 2 Fish Bits

**Glowing Medium Fish**

- Gives 4 Fish Bits

**Glowing Large Fish**

- Gives 10 Fish Bits

**Local Legend**

- Gives 25 Fish Bits

**Axolotl**

- Gives 25 Fish Bits

**Weight**

- 0.1 Pounds

**Spoil Rate**

- Base: 1.3 Hours
- 30% Reduced Spoil Rate: 1.6 hours
- 50% Reduced Spoil Rate: 1.9 hours
- 60% Reduced Spoil Rate: 2 hours
- 90% Reduced Spoil Rate: 2.4 Hours

**Crafted at**

- Cooking Station > All Food
- Cooking Station > Fish Bits

**Perk Cards and Effects**

- Super Duper: Works when crafting.
- Stacking Effects: 
 - N/A

**Obtained via**

- Plan: 
 - Auto learnt when you catch the fish for the first time

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a9d142aa7d1942ecb779aa80df29c9a7~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
